sources.name: indicvoices
sources.title: IndicVoices (AI4Bharat)
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (card tag and card text)
sources.attribution: IndicVoices, Javed et al., ACL Findings 2024 (AI4Bharat, IIT Madras); CC BY 4.0.
sources.notes: Gated (auto-approve). Verified on 2026-10-24 with a read-only account token (parquet footers and the text/duration/speaker columns of hi, kn and ta shards). Columns: audio_filepath (Audio struct), text, duration, lang, samples, verbatim, normalized, speaker_id, scenario, task_name, gender, age_group, job_type, qualification, area, district, state, occupation, verification_report, unsanitized_verbatim, unsanitized_normalized. `text` = `normalized` (textbook spelling, English loanwords in native script, tags mostly removed but `<unintelligible>` survives in some rows); `verbatim` = as spoken. `unsanitized_normalized` keeps the tags (<tag> or [tag], 89 Table-13 names, capitalised or misspelt at times) and adds a Latin gloss after English words: 'ಆರ್ಡರ್ [order] ಶಿಪ್‌ [ship]'. Rows with a gloss: hi valid 50%, kn 62%, ta 71% (train shard 0: hi 43%, kn 60%, ta 82%). IndicEAR reads `unsanitized_normalized`, rewrites glossed words to Latin (code_mixed rows) and drops unintelligible rows. Measured train hours (duration column, all shards): hi 819.4 (2,354 speakers), ta 803.9 (2,407), kn 616.2 (2,131). The Hub has train and valid only (no test). Valid speakers are almost all in train (hi 512/514, kn 218/220, ta 546/553); valid is used as a code-mixed eval set and its speakers are removed from training, which costs hi 192.6 h (24%), kn 71.8 h (12%), ta 201.1 h (25%) of the train split.

sources.name: vaani
sources.title: Vaani transcribed part (ARTPARK-IISc)
sources.attribution: VAANI, Pulikodan et al., arXiv 2603.28714 (IISc Bengaluru and ARTPARK, funded by Google); CC BY 4.0.
sources.notes: Gated with a form (name, company, purpose: Research/Academic/Commercial/Education). Card schema: audio (Audio), language, gender, state, district, transcript, referenceImage; splits train, validation, test. No speaker column: speakers are grouped by the uploader token in the file name (heuristic), and leaks are checked by audio hash. Markup verified from public Vaani transcripts (the portal's v1a JSON) and the Vaani-Benchmark card: '{english}' follows the native-script rendering of an English word (multi-word spans and glued suffixes occur), '{native}' and '(native)' give the standard spelling of a dialect form, '<noise> ... </noise>' wraps noisy speech, '<PAUSE>', '<static_noise>', '[breathing]', '[lip smacks]', '[unintelligible]', and '--' marks a cut-off word. Verified on 2026-10-24 on the HF rows of the main ARTPARK-IISc/Vaani repo (same project and transcripts; 80 of 100 transcribed Hindi rows in one shard carry {english}). Access was granted later the same day: the pilot streamed it, and a pilot shard (audio/Hindi/train-00132-of-00177.parquet, 2,401 rows) has exactly the card's columns audio, language, gender, state, district, transcript, referenceImage, with '{english}' glosses in the transcripts.

sources.name: vaani_main
sources.title: Vaani, full release (transcribed rows only)
sources.attribution: VAANI, Pulikodan et al., arXiv 2603.28714 (IISc Bengaluru and ARTPARK, funded by Google); CC BY 4.0.
sources.notes: Fallback while Vaani-transcription-part is not accessible. Verified with the project's token: config audio/<Language>, one train split (Hindi: 5,620 shards); columns audio, language, duration, speakerID, languagesKnown, gender, state, district, pincode, stay(years), isTranscriptionAvailable, transcript, referenceImage, speakerImageHash, UtteranceSequenceID. Only ~6% of rows are transcribed (100 of 1,799 in the first Hindi shard, spread over every row group), so each transcribed hour costs ~18 hours of download. speakerID can be 'NA'. Not used in the shipped mixtures.

sources.name: vaani_benchmark
sources.title: Vaani Benchmark v1.0 (Hindi)
sources.notes: Held-out collection distinct from Vaani. 5,050 segments, 1,103 speakers, ~10.9 h, three independent references per segment (multi-reference WER). Columns from the card table: audio, speakerID, language, state, district, duration, gender, reference_image, transcription_v1..v3. The notation table on its card is the source of the Vaani markup rules.

sources.name: indiccontext_eval
sources.title: IndicContextEval (AI4Bharat, entity-heavy)
sources.notes: Verified from a parquet footer and rows: audio, reference_text (English as 'वारंटी (Warranty)'), reference_text_with_tags, reference_text_no_tags, reference_text_no_brackets, language, duration, task_name, domain_name, speech_style, code_mixing (bool; 185 of 245 rows in one Hindi shard), speaker_id, context prompts l0-l6. Splits are named by language (bn, gu, hi, ml, mr, or, te, ur; no kn, ta or en): data/<Language>-*.parquet. 55.9 h in total (measured on 24 October 2026).

sources.name: indic_diarbench
sources.title: Indic DiarBench (Sarvam AI, multi-speaker long-form)
sources.notes: Registered, not loaded: whole recordings (Kannada: 89 rows) with columns audio, recording_id, language, annotated_transcript, dataset_type, sample_id, num_speakers, num_segments, duration_seconds; one test parquet per language. Needs long-form segmentation before it fits the <= 20 s eval path; code-mixing is not flagged. About 108 h (measured on 24 October 2026).

sources.name: kathbath
sources.title: Kathbath (AI4Bharat IndicSUPERB)
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (HF tag); the card text and IndicSUPERB README say CC0 for the packaging
sources.attribution: Kathbath / IndicSUPERB, Javed et al., arXiv 2208.11761 (AI4Bharat); CC BY 4.0 / CC0.
sources.notes: Tag conflict: the Hub tag is CC BY 4.0, while the card and the IndicSUPERB README license the packaging under CC0 and say the read text comes from the IndicCorp web crawl, which AI4Bharat does not own. Treated as CC BY 4.0 (the stricter reading) with attribution. Card schema: fname, text, audio_filepath (Audio), lang, duration, gender, speaker_id (int64); Hub splits train and valid. The test-known/test-unknown sets (clean and noisy) are only on the IndicSUPERB object store (`kathbath_test`). Test-known speakers also appear in train by design, so they are removed from training when that eval set is loaded.

sources.name: kathbath_test
sources.title: Kathbath test-known / test-unknown, clean and noisy
sources.revision: object-store tars pinned by size and ETag
sources.license: CC0 (IndicSUPERB README) / CC BY 4.0 (Hub tag of the same corpus)
sources.style: read; noisy = the same protocol with added noise
sources.attribution: Kathbath / IndicSUPERB, Javed et al., arXiv 2208.11761 (AI4Bharat).
sources.notes: Each tar holds all 12 languages, so it is downloaded whole. Audio is m4a (decoded with ffmpeg). Verified: transcripts are `kb_data_clean_m4a/<language>/<split>/transcription_n2w.txt` with '<file>\t<text>' lines and file names '<utterance>-<speaker>-<gender>.m4a' (read from the head of the clean transcripts tar). Unverified: the split directory names inside the test tars and the noisy transcript prefix; the loader discovers them and reports what it found.

sources.name: shrutilipi
sources.title: Shrutilipi (AI4Bharat, All India Radio)
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (card tag and card text)
sources.attribution: Shrutilipi, Bhogale et al., ICASSP 2023 (AI4Bharat); CC BY 4.0.
sources.notes: Mined audio-text pairs from All India Radio bulletins: labels can be misaligned. PLAN.md asks for a teacher-CER filter, which is not implemented, so Shrutilipi is only in the `full` mixture, not in `full_warm`. Card schema: audio_filepath (Audio), text, duration, lang; one train split; no speaker ids. No Urdu config despite the card text. On 2026-10-24 the file listing worked but reading a parquet file returned 403 (the project's account is not on the gated repo's authorized list), so no row was read.

sources.name: spring_inx
sources.title: SPRING-INX (SPRING Lab, IIT Madras)
sources.license: unconfirmed: no licence on the Hub repos; the IndiaAI AIKosh listing (Odia, Malayalam) says CC BY 4.0
sources.style: conversational and read; English words appear in Latin script
sources.attribution: SPRING-INX, SPRING Lab, IIT Madras, arXiv 2310.14654.
sources.notes: Schema verified from the Kannada R1 parquet footer: utterance_id, text, audio; splits train, validation, test; no speaker ids. No Hindi audio repo under SPRINGLab (speechlab/SPRING_INX_R1 holds Kaldi text files only). The SPRING Lab page (asr.iitm.ac.in/dataset) returned 404, so the licence was not read at the source: resolve before training (PLAN.md checklist 5).

sources.name: mucs
sources.title: MUCS 2021 sub-task 2 (Hindi-English, Bengali-English)
sources.revision: OpenSLR SLR104 tarballs pinned by size and ETag
sources.attribution: MUCS 2021 (Diwan et al., Interspeech 2021), OpenSLR SLR104; data from the Spoken Tutorial project, IIT Bombay; CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.notes: Share-alike: counsel review before training (PLAN.md checklist 3). Kaldi layout per the challenge baseline README: <split>/transcripts/{text,segments,utt2spk,wav.scp} plus <split>/<recording>.wav (the wav part seen in the head of the test tar). Transcripts mostly write English in Latin but some English words in Devanagari (seen in a public mirror). Hi-En 89.86 h train / 5.18 h test; Bn-En 46.11 h / 7.02 h; blind test set in subtask2_blindtest_wReadme.tar.gz (layout unverified).

sources.name: peoples_speech
sources.title: The People's Speech, CC BY subsets
sources.license: CC BY 2.0/2.5/3.0/4.0 (per item; the `clean`/`dirty` configs); `*_sa` configs are CC BY-SA and not used
sources.style: mixed spontaneous and prepared speech from archive.org (courts, forums, lectures); mostly US accents
sources.attribution: The People's Speech, Galvez et al., arXiv 2111.09344 (MLCommons); CC BY.
sources.notes: Only `clean/train-*` is read. The validation/test splits are shared across the CC BY and CC BY-SA configs, so they are not used. Schema verified from a parquet footer: id, audio, duration_ms, text (lower case). Transcripts come from existing captions and are partly misaligned (card). No speaker ids: the archive.org item in the id groups utterances. Open question: CC BY 2.0-4.0 attribution for individual archive.org works.

open_questions: SPRING-INX: no licence on the Hub repos and the SPRING Lab page 404s; only the IndiaAI AIKosh listing states CC BY 4.0. Confirm with IIT Madras before training.
MUCS (SLR104): CC BY-SA 4.0. Counsel review of share-alike obligations for model weights before training; if cleared, internal training only, never in anything redistributed.
IndicVoices: valid speakers overlap train (removed from training when valid is an eval set); public models trained on IndicVoices train may have seen the valid speakers.
Kathbath: Hub tag CC BY 4.0 vs CC0 in the card text; the read text comes from the IndicCorp crawl.
Lahaja: Hub tag MIT vs CC BY 4.0 in the card text (eval only).
Common Voice: Mozilla Data Collective terms and credentials; not a plain download.
IndicTTS: original IIT Madras licence not readable from here; mirrors disagree.
People's Speech: attribution for individual CC BY 2.0-4.0 archive.org works.
Shrutilipi: the project's account is not on the gated repo's authorized list (403 on a parquet read, 2026-10-24); rows unverified, and no teacher-CER filter. Not used in full_warm.
